source.description: Who wrote this mockup: chat (the dashboard chat), claude-code or codex. Set it when you create the spec.

built.description: Written when the mockup is built into real pages. Leave it out while the mockup is a draft: the Mockups page lists a mockup with it as Built and links each page. Also set each built page's livePage to the page it was built into, with the version the builder answered after the build: the Mockups page marks the mockup Out of sync once that page's version moves on.

at.description: When the build finished, an ISO 8601 date and time, e.g. 2026-11-13T10:00:00Z.

path.description: A path of the dashboard, such as "/orders": it starts with one "/", never "//" or "/\", and holds no whitespace or control character.

title.description: The link's text. The path is shown when it is absent.

livePage.description: The live page this page was converted from (Edit as mockup) or built into, and its version then. Build it updates that page instead of creating a new one.

version.description: Its source file's version at the conversion.

liveRoutes.description: The live route a fixture key stands for: with Real data on, an option "fixture:<key>" reads it instead of the fixture.

fixtures.description: Data a block reads: an option "fixture:<key>" is served from here.

title.description: Small heading at the top of the card.

count.description: A number shown beside the title; a data source can replace it.

badge.description: A short tag at the top of the card, such as the period it covers.

groupByDay.description: Day separators with times, rather than relative times.

visibleItems.description: Entries shown before a "Show N more" button unfolds the rest.

wrap.description: Entries wrap their texts rather than cutting them to one line.

fillHeight.description: Takes the full height of its place, the entries scrolling inside, rather than growing with them.

to.description: The page the button opens, or a web address.
